info.name: BUSCED CMS - Public API (v1)
info.description:
Public, unauthenticated endpoints of the BUSCED CMS.

Every endpoint lives under `/api/v1/`. Older paths such as `/api/staff` are rewritten onto these and still work, but should be treated as deprecated.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server, with no trailing slash.

**The saved examples are real responses**, captured by calling a running server against the live database. Document ids in the examples are real and will differ on your instance.

Endpoints NOT in this collection require a Bearer token: everything under `/api/v1/admin/` and `/api/v1/auth/`, plus `/api/v1/faqs`, `/api/v1/context`, `/api/v1/program-types`, `/api/v1/dashboard-summary`, and every write operation on the resources listed here.

request.description:
List schools (faculties), or one by `id`.

**Query**
- `id` - return a single school instead of the list.

The payload omits `createdAt`, `updatedAt` and `__v`.

response.name: 200 - list
200 - single
404 - not found
500 - malformed id

request.description:
List departments, or one by `id`.

**Query**
- `id` - return a single department.
- `schoolId` - only departments belonging to that school.

Each department has its parent `faculty` populated.

request.description:
List programmes, or one by `id`.

**Query**
- `id` - return a single programme.
- `limit` - return that many programmes chosen **at random** (via `$sample`), not the first N.

Without `limit` the full list is returned, newest first. `faculty`, `department` and `programType` are populated.

request.description:
List staff, one by `id`, or a slim list for a single department.

**Query**
- `id` - return one staff member, fully populated.
- `page` - enable pagination. **Without `page` the entire list is returned** in the older `{ success, staff }` envelope, with no counts.
- `limit` - page size. Default 20, maximum 100.
- `q` - case-insensitive match on `fullName`, `email` or `position`.
- `onlystaff=true` **together with** `id` - staff of that **department**, with a reduced field set, returned under `data` instead of `staff`.

Sorted newest first (`createdAt`, then `_id` as tie-breaker).

response.name: 200 - list (unpaginated)
200 - paginated
200 - search
200 - search no match

request.description:
**Published articles only** (`isActive: true`). Unpublished work is never returned here - the list excludes it and a lookup by `id` returns 404. Use the authenticated `/api/v1/admin/news?status=inactive` to see drafts.

**Query**
- `id` - return a single published article.
- `page` - default 1.
- `limit` - default 10, maximum 100.
- `search` - case-insensitive match on `title` or `content`.

Sorted newest first.

request.description:
Contact form. Emails the submission to the address configured as `EMAIL_RECEIVER`.

**Body** - all four required
- `fullName`
- `email` - must look like an email address.
- `subject` - **more than 15 characters**.
- `message` - **more than 30 characters**.

The response is sent **before** the mail is dispatched, so `200` confirms the submission was accepted, not that the email was delivered. A later SMTP failure is logged server-side only.

request.description:
Answers a visitor question. Tries the FAQ collection first, then the stored context, then falls back to Gemini.

**Body**
- `message` - the visitor's question.

Returns `{ reply }` - this endpoint does **not** use the `success` envelope. If every stage fails, the reply is the fallback string "I'm not sure. Please contact the school."
